---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Deborah McCook <dlmc...@ucdavis.edu>
Date: Mon, Feb 22, 2016 at 11:25 AM
Subject: [gradfund] FW: Insight Data Science and Engineering Fellowships - June 2016
To: "post...@ucdavis.edu" <post...@ucdavis.edu>, "grad...@ucdavis.edu" <grad...@ucdavis.edu>, Jessica M Stoller <jsto...@ucdavis365.onmicrosoft.com>


The Insight Data Programs are tuition-free post-graduate Fellowships for students and postdocs looking to transition to careers in data science or data engineering.

A number of alumni from UC Davis have gone through the program, including Heather Shapiro (Neuroscience), Michael Woods (Physics), and Chris Miller (Physics), who are now data scientists at Pebble, Yelp, and Rentlytics respectively. We haven’t had Fellows from UC Davis recently, but would love to increase UC Davis graduate participation in Insight.

Thank you,
Wafa Soofi
Program Director | Insight Data Science

==================
Insight Fellows Programs

Now accepting applications for Summer 2016 Insight Fellowships

500+ Insight alumni are now data scientists and data engineers at Facebook, LinkedIn, The New York Times, Apple, Airbnb, Netflix, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, Uber, Seven Bridges Genomics, Twitter, Bloomberg, NBC, Microsoft, and 100+ other top companies.

Insight Fellowship:
  * 7 week, full-time, post-graduate training Fellowship
  * Mentorship from leading industry data scientists and data engineers
  * Join an active community of Insight alumni
  * Self-directed, project-based learning with support from Insight throughout the whole process
  * Tuition-free with need-based scholarships available to help cover living costs

Insight awards three distinct Fellowships:

Data Science (New York City, Silicon Valley & remote)
Deadline: March 21st
For post-docs or PhD students who will graduate by October 2016
http://insightdatascience.com

Health Data Science (Boston)
Deadline: March 21st
For post-docs, MD, or PhD students who will graduate by October 2016
http://insighthealthdata.com

Data Engineering (New York City & Silicon Valley)
Deadline: March 28th
For post-docs or Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD students who will graduate by October 2016
http://insightdataengineering.com

Questions? Email us at in...@insightdatascience.com
